text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A after a modest gain, but locking in a win is not by itself a sound reason to sell; I should focus on its prospects and my overall plan.","I should not hold a losing position just to avoid admitting a mistake. Average cost is not a reason to keep owning a stock.","Short-term price moves are random, so I should avoid reacting to them and make deliberate decisions when I review my portfolio."]}
